meaning:
ῥιζόω, -ῶ
(ῥίζα), [in LXX: Isa.40:24, Jer.12:2 (שָׁרַשׁ), Sir.3:28 24:12 * ;]
to cause to take root. Metaphorical, to plant, fix firmly, establish: pass. (EV, rooted), ἐν ἀγάπῃ, Eph.3:18(17); ἐν Χριστῷ, Col.2:7 (cf. ἐκ ριζόω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
